description: Manually created evaluation cases (Phase 25). Expected conditions, categories and hypotheses follow the documented rules in app/config/*.yaml; they are checked against the ACTUAL retrieved dataset records, never against invented answers. expected_output is a short reference written by hand for DeepEval's contextual-precision metric.

cases.query: Cell has high latency and high packet loss. What similar network conditions occurred before?
cases.expected_output: Similar historical records show high latency and high packet loss. A transport or inter-cell connectivity degradation is a plausible hypothesis; check transport latency and loss and monitor latency and packet loss after remediation.

cases.query: Poor signal strength and frequent call drops on a cell.
cases.expected_output: Similar records show weak signal strength with high call drop rates. Radio coverage or signal-quality degradation is the leading hypothesis; investigate coverage and interference and monitor call drops.

cases.query: High user load with reduced throughput on the cell.
cases.expected_output: Similar records show high user load together with low throughput. Capacity congestion is a plausible hypothesis; review cell capacity and load balancing and monitor throughput against load.

cases.query: Handover success rate is low on several cells.
cases.expected_output: Similar records show low handover success. A mobility configuration issue (neighbour relations or handover parameters) is the leading hypothesis; analyse per cell-pair handover counters and audit neighbour relations.

cases.query: High alarm count and many critical alarms at a site.
cases.expected_output: Similar records show high alarm and critical alarm counts. An equipment fault indicated by alarms is a plausible hypothesis; prioritise resolving critical alarms and monitor fault occurrence.

cases.query: Many authentication failures reported on the network.
cases.expected_output: Similar records show high authentication failures. A security or authentication anomaly is a plausible hypothesis; escalate to security operations and review failure patterns.

cases.query: Low connection setup success for users trying to connect.
cases.expected_output: Similar records show low connection setup success. An access or connection-setup procedure issue is the leading hypothesis; analyse setup failure causes and monitor setup success.

cases.query: High fault occurrence rate in a network region.
cases.expected_output: Similar records show a high fault occurrence rate. Equipment faults indicated by alarms or weather-related degradation are plausible hypotheses; review alarms and correlate with weather.
